scripts.dev: npm run build:web && wrangler dev --env local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run api:generate && npm run build:web
scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --env local
scripts.db:staging: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.deploy: node scripts/wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && npm run check:deployment -- --env staging && npm run db:staging && node scripts/wrangler.mjs deploy --env staging

DB.description: Authoritative tasks, leases and history. Use a separate database per environment.

APP_SIGNING_SECRET.description: Generate 32 random bytes. Never use the public INSTANCE_EPOCH as a secret.

INSTANCE_EPOCH.description: Random recovery generation. Preserve on upgrades; rotate after restore.
